headline: Here’s how you can save on GTA VI ahead of launch
summary: GTA VI launches next Friday, November 19th. Discover how to save money on your digital copy using gift card discounts. This clever workaround helps reduce the cost of the highly anticipated game.

headline: You can adjust the position of the trackball on Keychron’s new wireless mouse
summary: Keychron introduces its new T1 HE wireless trackball mouse. A unique feature allows users to adjust the trackball's position for ergonomic comfort. The design resembles popular trackball mice from Logitech and Kensington.

headline: Jensen Huang was reckless with the environment, too
summary: Nvidia, under Jensen Huang, is identified as a significant environmental liability in the AI boom. Its chip production demands extensive water, chemicals, and energy, straining power grids. Concerns are rising over massive data center consumption and a looming e-waste problem.

headline: The smallest version of Camp Snap’s retro digital camcorder fits on your keychain
summary: Camp Snap unveils the CS-8 Micro, an even smaller retro digital camcorder. This screen-free video camera is designed to be compact enough to fit on a keychain. It follows their previous miniaturized CS-8 model, further shrinking its hardware.

headline: MagicCon Atlanta Preview Panel Liveblog
summary: Follow the liveblog for real-time updates from the MagicCon Atlanta Preview Panel. Get immediate announcements and insights from the event. Dive into new details revealed during the MagicCon session.

headline: Crazy Taxi: World Tour Final Map Revealed
summary: India is confirmed as the final map for Crazy Taxi: World Tour. The map features three distinct zones celebrating India’s diverse cultures. Expect Bollywood film influences to be prominently featured.

headline: The Lenovo Legion Pro 7i Combines Gaming, Versatility, and Portability in One Premium Package
summary: The Lenovo Legion Pro 7i delivers a powerful gaming experience. It offers impressive versatility for various computing tasks. This premium laptop prioritizes portability without compromising performance.

headline: Marvel Confirms the Avengers Team Lineup That Anthony Mackie's Captain America Will Lead in Doomsday
summary: Marvel confirms the Avengers team lineup for the upcoming 'Doomsday' movie. Anthony Mackie's Captain America is set to lead this new roster of heroes. The full team is revealed ahead of the film's premiere next month.

headline: Police investigating David Walliams over reports alleging serious sexual offences
summary: Police are investigating David Walliams regarding reports of serious sexual offenses. These allegations are separate from those previously reported by ITV and The Guardian. The Met Police confirms an ongoing inquiry into the matter.

headline: Microsoft outage 'stark reminder' of how much we rely on tech
summary: Microsoft apologized for a recent outage caused by a technical failure. The incident served as a stark reminder of our deep reliance on technology. It highlighted the critical role tech plays in daily life and business operations.

headline: Former Hamas bodyguard guilty of UK knife attack
summary: Mohammed Alfatih, a former Hamas bodyguard, was found guilty of a knife attack in the UK. He was granted asylum in the UK in 2015. Alfatih obtained British citizenship in 2020 prior to the conviction.

headline: Watch: BBC undercover reporter is offered fake art and awards for talent visa
summary: A BBC investigation revealed companies offering fraudulent UK talent visa applications. Migrants were coached to pose as talented artists using fake art and awards. An undercover reporter exposed these illicit practices designed to facilitate visa fraud.
